capabilities: Publish the current note to Ghost as a draft, published, or scheduled post
Convert Obsidian markdown and wiki links to Ghost-compatible HTML
Upload local images to Ghost and rewrite references to CDN URLs
Edit title, tags, status, and featured flag in a pre-publish modal
Move published notes to an archive folder with updated links
extras: Installation is manual (copying release files into the plugins folder) rather than through the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a Ghost blog, including converting markdown and uploading local images.

relations.evidence: Publish your Obsidian notes directly to Ghost blogs with automatic image uploads

summary: Ghost publishing plugin that pushes notes to a Ghost blog with image uploads, metadata editing, scheduled posts, and optional archiving.
